note: Bank of Cyprus's commissions and charges for physical persons (June 2026): its VISA CLASSIC credit card's annual membership fee is 12.50 euros for the cardholder, and its credit cards' interest rate is 11.50% a year (11.25% for an eCredit card applied for through 1bank, not written).

sources.said: June 2026 ... 5.1 Commissions and Charges for Credit Cards ... VISA CLASSIC €12,50 €5 ... Interest Rate 11,50%
